records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The sharp sequential decline in revenue was primarily the result of severe weather disruptions, certain project delays, COVID-19 shutdowns in Southeast Asia, and raw material shortages for the segment’s Fiberglass business unit.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: New orders booked during the quarter totaled $338 million, representing a book-to-bill of 127 percent when compared to the $267 million of orders shipped from backlog.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: At March 31, 2021, backlog for capital equipment orders for Completion & Production Solutions was $810 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The average per barrel price of West Texas Intermediate Crude Oil increased 36 percent (from $42.46 per barrel to $57.80 per barrel) and natural gas prices increased 42 percent (from $2.50 per mmbtu to $3.56 per mmbtu) in the first quarter of 2021 compared to the fourth quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating loss for the first quarter of 2021 was $88 million, compared to an operating loss of $301 million in the fourth quarter of 2020 and an operating loss of $1,950 million in the first quarter of 2020.
